Dear day crew,
The training lead reviewed an idea about route planning earlier today, and I wanted to pass it on.

The main point is simple: keep the pre-departure guidance clear, steady, and easy to follow. When a traveler is uneasy about a pet, listen first, then confirm the options without rushing the conversation. This desk works best when each handoff is calm and the next step is stated plainly.

Please keep checking that the notes are complete before the file moves on, and flag anything that could affect kennel space, carrier fit, or transfer handling. We should treat every journey as a shared responsibility, not as a single desk task. If a case feels uncertain, bring it forward at once so the team can review it together and avoid avoidable confusion.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
